intro: Football is Kuwait's main sport, and its team was once the best in Asia.

chapters.title: Football
text: Kuwait won the Asian Cup in 1980 and played at the 1982 World Cup, the first Arab team from Asia to do so. It has won the Gulf Cup many times.

chapters.title: Shooting
text: Fehaid Al-Deehani won Olympic gold in 2016 while competing under the Olympic flag, as Kuwait was suspended.

keyTerms.meaning: A football tournament between Gulf countries.

items.text: Kuwait have won it ten times.
